title: Setting Up Slack
text: Following steps Slack API Docs: https://docs.slack.dev/app-management/quickstart-app-settings App Name: promoutils Workspace: rOpenSci Go OAuth & Permissions, scroll “Scopes” Add “User Token Scopes” channels:history channels:read chat:write files:read groups:read groups:write groups:history im:write users:read Go OAuth & Permissions > OAuth Tokens > “Install rOpenSci” (authorizes ‘promoutils’ act behalf) Copy Token add keyring R: keys_set("slack") (uses keyring hood). Note: activate OAuth Token rotation requires secure redirect URL means can’t use http://localhost redirect URL gets complicated. leave token based, don’t rotate token, need keep token safe. Therefore use keyring. Now ’re ready start working Slack functions promoutils.
